name: Shamsheer Vayalil
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2017-2025); Hurun Global (2017-2026); Hurun India (2017-2020)
forbes_bio: Shamsheer Vayalil is founder and chairman of Burjeel Holdings, a network of hospitals, clinics and pharmacies in the Middle East.
His net worth got a boost from the 2022 listing of Burjeel Holdings, which has used Bollywood superstar Shah Rukh Khan as its brand ambassador.
Born into a business family in Kerala state, he migrated to the Middle East after his medical studies and worked as a radiologist at a local hospital.
Backed initially by his father-in-law, Gulf retailing billionaire M.A. Yusuff Ali, Vayalil started with one hospital in Abu Dhabi in 2007. Burjeel now has 19 hospitals and 29 medical centres.
Vayalil was vice chairman of investment firm Amanat Holdings until 2022. He remains chairman of listed Response Plus Holdings, a provider of medical services.
forbes_facts: Egyptian national Eman Ahmed, once billed as 'the world's heaviest woman', was treated free of cost at Vayalil's Burjeel Hospital until her death in September 2017.
Vayalil has signed the Giving Pledge.

name: Kushal Desai
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026)
forbes_bio: Kushal is chairman and managing director of  Mumbai-based Apar Industries.
The 68-year-old company manufactures and supplies conductors, electrical cables, speciality oils, polymers and lubricants.
His younger brother Chaitanya is Apar's managing director.
Apar was originally called Power Cables when it was set up in 1958 by his late father Dharamsinh Desai.
forbes_facts: His mother Maithili Desai hails from the Mafatlal family, an old textile clan.

name: Zhou Yaoting
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2015-2018); Hurun Global (2014-2025); Hurun China (2005-2024)
forbes_bio: Zhou Yaoting controls China's Hodo Group, which has interests in apparel, real estate and finance.
Apparel maker Hongdou had its humble beginnings in 1957 when Zhou Yaoting's father founded the cotton processing operation with three employees.
Months after, local officials forced him to merge with two other businesses into what was in effect a government-controlled collective.
The family over time bought back government shares, paving the way for new growth that has made the business one China's largest apparel makers.

name: Sam Pollock
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun Global (2026)
forbes_bio: Sam Pollock is the CEO of Brookfield Infrastructure, a spinoff of Toronto-based Brookfield which invests in industries like utilities and data storage.
Pollock has worked for Brookfield since 1994 in several senior roles, including leading its private equity business.
Brookfield raised $30 billion for its fifth flagship infrastructure fund in 2023, the largest such fund ever raised by an investment firm.
Brookfield Infrastructure Partners' publicly-traded stock has generated a 14% annualized return since inception in 2008.

name: Stefan Pierer
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2024); Forbes annual (2018-2023); Hurun Global (2015-2024)
forbes_bio: Stefan Pierer is the CEO of $1.7 billion (sales) Pierer Mobility, one of the leading motorcycle manufacturers based in Austria.
Pierer founded Cross holding group (now Pierer Industrie) in 1987 and is still its majority shareholder.
He is also a member of the Supervisory Board of auto parts company SHW AG.
He began his career as a sales assistant at heating and air conditioning maker Hoval.

name: Kwek Leng Keow
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2023-2025); Hurun Global (2024-2026)
forbes_bio: Kwek Leng Keow inherited a stake in Hong Leong Group from his father, Kwek Hong Leong, whose brother, Kwek Hong Png, founded the group in 1941.
Kwek Leng Keow is the brother of Kwek Leng Peck, who is the executive chairman of Singapore-listed Hong Leong Asia, which makes, trades and distributes cement and steel products.
He's the managing director of Hong Realty, a unit of Hong Leong Investment Holdings.

name: George Christ
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun Global (2026); SEC insider holdings (2025)
forbes_bio: George Christ cofounded software company Altair Engineering with fellow billionaire James Scapa in 1985.
Christ retired before Altair went public in 2017 but remained the company's second largest individual shareholder until it was acquired by German tech giant Siemens in 2025.
Siemens paid nearly $10 billion in cash for Altair and Christ walked away with $1 billion before taxes.

name: Denis Sverdlov
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2022); Hurun Global (2021-2022); Hurun Unicorn founders (2020)
forbes_bio: Denis Sverdlov is the founder and CEO of electric vehicle startup Arrival.
Sverdlov founded Arrival in 2015, using capital from the sale of Russian phone maker Yota in 2012.
Arrival makes lightweight, zero-emission vans at a competitive price to diesel- and gasoline-powered vehicles.
He took Arrival public on the Nasdaq, via a merger with a SPAC, in March 2021.
Born in communist Georgia, Sverdlov served as Russia's Deputy Minister of Communications in 2012.

name: Huang Chulong
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2015-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Hurun China (2012-2026)
forbes_bio: Huang Chulong chairs Galaxy Group, a privately held business based in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen.
Huang's business interests span hotels, shopping malls, office leasing, parking-lot operation and real estate development.
Huang holds a controlling stake in Hong Kong-listed real estate management company E-Star Commercial Management.

name: Wang Zhendong
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2019-2021); Hurun Global (2019-2022); Hurun China (2019-2022)
forbes_bio: Wang Zhendong is a cofounder and the general manager of Offcn Education Technology.
Offcn completed a backdoor listing on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2019.
Offcn provides online and offline training for applicants of civil service exams.
The company has centers and schools in 319 Chinese cities, and currently enrolls 1.4 million students.
Wang owns 15.6% of Offcn.

forbes_bio: Ling Bin chairs Shenzhen KTC, a supplier of flat panel displays.
The company went public at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2022.
Shenzhen KTC was founded in 1995.

name: Ong Leong Huat
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026)
forbes_bio: Ong Leong Huat is the executive chairman and majority shareholder of financial services company OSK Holdings.
He is also the executive chairman of its property arm, OSK Property Holdings.
He was appointed non-executive chairman of OSK Ventures International, the group's venture capital and private equity firm, in 2023.
OSK Holdings and OSK Ventures International are listed in Malaysia.
OSK Holdings has a minority stake in RHB Bank, one of Malaysia's largest banks by assets.
